Medium: following it has the agent install ArgoCD into the user's cluster via `kubectl apply` of the upstream install manifest, read the initial admin password from a Kubernetes secret, and run state-changing argocd commands (sync, sync --force, rollback, delete). Acceptable because these are standard GitOps operations on the user's own cluster and the delete/force commands are presented as a CLI reference, not as steps to run automatically; confirm with the user before syncing, rolling back or deleting production apps.
